enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arms. Turn onto back. Remain still. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Apply soap to face. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl and pan. Close cupboard. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour egg mixture into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Place eggs on plate. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Wait for toast. Remove toast. Spread butter. Pour milk into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Stand up. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on work clothes. Open drawer. Take out socks. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Place laptop in bag. Place phone in bag. Place keys in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Accelerate. Turn right. Drive. Park car. Unfasten seatbelt. Open car door. Step out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a day shift as a health care professional, seeing patients and updating care records
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Change into scrubs. Wash hands. Review patient charts. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update records on computer. Attend meeting. Eat lunch. Return to work. See more patients. Update records. Consult with colleagues. Wash hands. Change out of scrubs.

Walk out of hospital. Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Drive. Stop at traffic light. Accelerate. Turn left. Drive. Park car. Unfasten seatbelt. Open car door. Step out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and freshening up after work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Take off clothes. Turn on water heater. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Turn off light.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out cutting board and knife. Close cupboard. Chop vegetables. Chop meat. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir. Add vegetables. Stir. Add sauce. Cook. Turn off induction cooker. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into trash. Open dishwasher. Load dishes into dishwasher. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with cloth. Wipe stove. Sweep floor. Put away cutting board and knife. Turn off light.

Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out snack. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry with the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine. Put clothes in washing machine. Close washing machine. Add detergent. Turn on washing machine. Wait. Open washing machine. Take out clothes. Put clothes in dryer. Turn on dryer. Wait. Take out clothes. Fold clothes. Turn off light.

Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Like a post. Close app. Open messaging app. Send a message. Close app. Put down phone. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Read. Put down book. Turn off desk lamp.
Walk to bathroom. Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Apply moisturizer. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.
Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Move arms. Turn onto back. Remain still. Sleep.
